mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE active_auth AS ( SELECT * FROM auth WHERE parent_id = 0 AND status = 1 UNION ALL SELECT a.* FROM auth a JOIN active_auth p ON a.parent_id = p.id WHERE a.status = 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM auth WHERE type IN ('M', 'C') ORDER BY id;

SELECT DISTINCT a.* FROM user_role ur JOIN role r ON ur.role_id = r.id JOIN role_auth ra ON r.id = ra.role_id JOIN active_auth a ON ra.auth_id = a.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND a.status = 1 AND a.type IN ('M', 'C') ORDER BY a.id;

SELECT DISTINCT a.code FROM user_role ur JOIN role r ON ur.role_id = r.id JOIN role_auth ra ON r.id = ra.role_id JOIN active_auth a ON ra.auth_id = a.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND a.status = 1 AND a.type IN ('C', 'F') AND a.code IS NOT NULL;
SELECT DISTINCT code FROM active_auth WHERE status = 1 AND type IN ('C', 'F') AND code IS NOT NULL;
